source: closed-form from CDL spec (_spec/03,02,01; CDL §7.x); independent re-derivation
compare_regime: bit-exact for finite; Inf/NaN by IEEE class (Value::bit_eq)
input: params uMin=0.0, uMax=5.5; u=[NaN,+inf,-inf,5.5,0.0,2.2]: NaN passes through fail-visible, infinities clamp to the bounds, boundary-equal u returns verbatim
reference_rule: y = if u > uMax then uMax elseif u < uMin then uMin else u; NaN fails both comparisons and reaches y (upstream Reals/Limiter.mo); oracle-diff for the 2026-07-06 NaN-absorption divergence fix
format: Modelica CombiTimeTable CSV (_spec/07 §9); signal CSV is time+one output; reference.csv is time+inputs+all outputs; ryu shortest-round-trip f64
